convergence.exportInvocation: pen interactive --in <file.pen> --out <file.pen>; execute({ input: 'Export(["default","narrow-one-column"], "png", "<dir>")' }) — default scale 2; the .pen MUST sit at its committed lane path so the relative library import and font URL resolve. Re-export verified byte-identical across consecutive runs (both frames).
convergence.comparison: pixelmatch 5.3.0 threshold 0.1, per-state budget 1.0% (dispatch default; contract pixelThreshold 0.03 is the looser Gate-1 story budget); targets = NORMALIZED prototype, contract root #cs-ov-pc, Chromium 151.0.7922.34 (playwright 1.62.1), viewports 1280x900 (default) / 480x900 (narrow-one-column), deviceScaleFactor 2, --disable-lcd-text --font-render-hinting=none (GC-009 capture fact: Linux LCD subpixel AA poisons the compare against pen's grayscale rasterizer), document.fonts.ready awaited, no motion exists to freeze (design-rules 12). Heebo served to the target render from the same TTF the .pen references (pencil/designs/fonts/Heebo-VariableFont_wght.ttf). Narrow-state capture applied the extraction-verification steps.json integer-offset discipline: the standalone's #cs-ov-pc sat at y=108.5 in the 480x900 viewport, shimmed by body margin-top 0.5px (a uniform capture-grid translation at DPR 2, no rendering change inside the section).
convergence.iterationNotes: It 1: authored from the measured normalized-prototype geometry (targets/geometry.json — all boxes integer, matching design-rules G1/G2 exactly) and converged immediately at 0.030%/0.033%. All 12px label text (600, 0.75px tracking) and 16px body text rasterized byte-identically to grayscale Chromium — zero text diff pixels (extends GC-009's 14/15px finding down to 12px). The entire residual (183 device px per state) is edge AA on the six 13px stroked glyphs (pen stroked-path rasterization vs Chromium's rasterized SVG mask), ~30 device px per glyph, visually indistinguishable at crop inspection. Chip tint circles (accent fill at node opacity 0.16/0.14 over the surface-white frame) matched the prototype's color-mix compositing exactly, including edge AA.
convergence.geometryProbesDetail: Probes derived from design-rules 1/4/5/8/9 (G1/G2/G3 vectors) asserted on the export pixels: frame dims exactly 2048x296 (default) / 880x640 (narrow) at 2x = the contract's 1024x148 / 440x320; chip tint present at every chip center row (rows y=44/86/128 per column, x=col+4 — off the glyph box) with the exact composited tint values (#148338@16% over white = rgb(217,235,223) pros, #C82320@14% = rgb(247,224,224) cons, tol 12); white clearance above each chip (the 10px top offset, G3); white gutter at x=col+30 (the 24px chip + 14px gap = 38px text offset, rule 4); white column gap at x=512 (default — the 48px gap, rule 8); white row gap at y=160 (narrow — the 24px stacked gap, rule 9). 22/22 pass on default, 22/22 on narrow.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: pros accent (label ink, check glyph, chip tint base — the --pos-strong role)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The handoff spec names a dedicated --hem-pros-accent role that hemlock-library does not carry. Amanda's pair is cross-assembled from primitives (green-500 light / green-350 dark) and coincides exactly with sem-text-deposit — but that role is 'Income / deposit values', a hue-match, not the pros-list role (the Iron Law forbids binding by light-mode appearance). sem-text-success-title owns the nearest role but diverges in light (#10642B vs #148338), which would silently restyle a deliberately-specified product intent ('TRIAL v2, exact per handoff spec'). Created the T3 component pair with Amanda's exact values; adopt-vs-remap is the designer's call, recorded in designGaps.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: cons accent (label ink, minus glyph, chip tint base — the --neg-strong role)
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: Same gap, harder: NO existing pair matches both modes (sem-text-error-title = #C82320/#F87171 — dark differs; sem-borders-error-strong = #961A18/#FCA5A5 — light differs). Amanda's pair is red-600 light / red-250 dark, cross-assembled. Created with her exact values.

tokenJudgmentCalls.surface: chip tint circles (both columns, both states)
tokenJudgmentCalls.prototypeValue: color-mix(in srgb, accent 16%, transparent) pros / 14% cons, over the transparent column
tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The prototype derives tints from the SAME accent pair so one rule themes both modes (design-rules 5); expressing them as node opacity on the accent-bound fill preserves that derivation — no separate tint tokens minted, dark mode rethemes automatically. Composited result over the surface-white frame is pixel-identical to Chromium's color-mix (probe-verified).

The 1.5 ratio exists in the scale as the base-step ratio; bound it rather than minting a duplicate. CROSS-PAIRED: the scale pairs xs(12) with line-height-xs (1.3333) — recorded as a designGap for the adopt-vs-remap ruling (same pattern GC-009 recorded).

tokenJudgmentCalls.rationale: The bare columns have no background of their own (design-rules 1); the captured backdrop is the card the section sits in, whose role is 'Main surface / card bg'. Bound the role, not the hue.
